如何设置导航组件标题栏的动态模糊效果？
如何配置半模态页面样式和自定义标题栏区域？

如何设置底部页签栏的分割线、模糊样式和悬浮样式？

当你的应用需要使用符合HarmonyOS设计规范的高端UI组件时使用本Kit，例如需要动态模糊标题栏、流光效果、按压阴影等沉浸式视觉体验的场景
当需要对应用图标进行分层处理、剪切、缩放、描边等批量操作时，或者需要注册自定义Symbol图标资源时，应使用本Kit的图标处理能力
当ArkUI基础组件无法满足你的视觉设计需求时，可以考虑使用UI Design Kit提供的增强型组件
本Kit支持模拟器开发，但模拟器不支持HDS沉浸视效相关能力
实现符合 Harmony Design System 的页面布局和组件样式 / Implement page layouts and component styles that follow the Harmony Design System
给应用接入统一的主题色、圆角、间距和字体规范 / Apply consistent theme colors, corner radius, spacing, and typography guidelines
设计带沉浸式光效和阴影反馈的界面视觉效果 / Design immersive UI visuals with light effects and shadow feedback
实现支持折叠屏和平板的自适应多栏界面 / Build adaptive multi-pane layouts for foldables and tablets
配置导航栏、标题栏和内容区的整体视觉层级 / Configure the visual hierarchy of navigation bar, title bar, and content area
实现带模糊背景和悬浮效果的底部导航与侧边菜单 / Create bottom navigation and side menus with blur backgrounds and floating styles
设计列表、卡片和操作区的统一交互动效 / Design consistent interaction animations for lists, cards, and action areas
为设置页和详情页套用系统化的页面模板 / Apply standardized page templates for settings and detail screens
实现应用图标、菜单图标和状态标记的统一视觉规范 / Standardize visuals for app icons, menu icons, and status badges
配置通知提示、红点提醒和快捷操作入口的界面样式 / Style notification prompts, badge indicators, and quick action entry points
实现分栏导航、嵌入式面板和覆盖式面板的界面结构 / Implement split navigation, embedded panels, and overlay panels
优化深色模式下的界面对比度、光效和层次表现 / Optimize contrast, lighting effects, and visual depth for dark mode
do_not_use_when: 需求是处理触控、鼠标、键盘等多模输入事件，或做光标控制与事件拦截，应改用 input-kit / The task is to handle multimodal input events such as touch, mouse, and keyboard, or manage cursors and event interception; use input-kit instead
preconditions: 工程已集成并启用可用的HarmonyOS UI Design Kit相关SDK能力 / The project has integrated and enabled the required HarmonyOS UI Design Kit SDK capability

目标设备或运行环境支持所选能力，且若使用HDS沉浸视效需在真机上验证而非仅依赖模拟器 / The target device or runtime supports the selected feature, and HDS immersive effects must be validated on real hardware rather than relying only on the emulator
应用已有ArkUI页面与组件开发基础，并可在对应页面中挂载扩展组件或样式 / The app already uses ArkUI pages/components and can host the extended components or styles in the relevant page
若进行图标批处理或Symbol注册，输入资源文件已准备且满足接口数量与并发限制 / If performing icon batch processing or Symbol registration, the input assets are prepared and meet the API limits for count and concurrency
inputs: 页面布局与组件配置需求 / page layout and component configuration requirements
视觉效果参数，如模糊、阴影、流光或光感材质配置 / visual effect parameters such as blur, shadow, shimmer, or light-material settings
图标资源或分层图标描述对象 / icon assets or layered icon descriptor objects
自定义Symbol图标及动效资源 / custom Symbol icon and animation resources
outputs: 符合 HarmonyOS Design System 的增强型导航组件界面 / HDS-compliant enhanced navigation component UI
带动态模糊、半模态或自定义标题栏的导航页面 / Navigation pages with dynamic blur, semi-modal style, or custom title bar
Overlay 或 Embed 模式侧边栏容器 / Sidebar container in overlay or embed mode
带一级/二级菜单、红点提醒的侧边栏菜单界面 / Sidebar menu UI with primary/secondary items and badge indicators
带分割线、背景模糊、悬浮或图标出血效果的底部页签栏 / Bottom tab bar with divider, background blur, floating style, or icon-bleed effect
常驻型或定时型即时操作通知弹窗 / Persistent or scheduled instant-action notification pop-up
带主按钮展开/收起动效或无主按钮样式的核心操作栏 / Core action bar with primary-button expand/collapse animation or no-primary-button style

点光源、流光、按压阴影、沉浸光感材质等 HDS 沉浸视效 / HDS immersive visual effects such as point light, light streak, press shadow, and immersive light material
合成、剪切、缩放或描边后的分层图标资源 / Layered icon resources after composition, clipping, scaling, or outlining

postconditions.statement: 已在ArkUI页面代码中引入并使用至少一种UI Design Kit增强组件、视效或图标处理能力 / At least one UI Design Kit enhanced component, visual effect, or icon-processing capability is introduced and used in the ArkUI page code
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set clearly add or configure a UI Design Kit capability such as enhanced navigation/sidebar/tab/list/multi-window components, HDS immersive effects, icon processing, or custom Symbol registration?

postconditions.statement: 实现内容体现为界面结构、样式或视觉效果增强，而非测试、性能分析或无障碍业务逻辑 / The implementation results in UI structure, styling, or visual enhancement rather than test, performance-analysis, or accessibility business logic
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is the primary change a UI design/styling enhancement instead of adding testing, performance analysis, localization, or accessibility logic?

postconditions.statement: 若使用HDS沉浸视效或图标处理，相关参数与资源引用已在代码中完成配置 / If HDS immersive effects or icon processing are used, the related parameters and asset references are configured in code
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the edits involve immersive visual effects or icon processing, do they include concrete parameter settings or asset/resource references rather than only placeholder comments?
